subject.title: fix(ci): stop Plugin SDK baseline drift after concurrent merges

question: Should this protected CI-guard change be rebased and revalidated against current `main` before it is accepted as the canonical Plugin SDK contract-manifest design?
rationale: The implementation is narrowly scoped and supported by supplied proof, but this branch changes automation that must represent the combined current-main SDK surface; the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Refresh and validate the merge result
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, regenerate the manifest only if needed, and require the Plugin SDK contract check plus focused tests on the refreshed head before merge.

options.title: Accept the current head
options.body: Merge without a refresh only if a maintainer has independently confirmed the reported clean merge result preserves every current-main Plugin SDK contract record.

recommendation.title: Refresh and validate the merge result
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main`, regenerate the manifest only if needed, and require the Plugin SDK contract check plus focused tests on the refreshed head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this contributor directly to the manifest design and its concurrency proof.
